name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Smoother, faster playback of friends' titles that the friend converts. Seeking works: a player asking again for a segment that is still being made now waits for it instead of making the friend's server restart its conversion (which could repeat forever on a slow start). Plays start sooner: your server starts the friend's conversion and fetches the next playlist while the player is still on its way. A friend restarting no longer refuses every play: your server gets fresh playback tokens and retries, and tokens now survive a restart. The friend's conversion log of each play is copied into your Dashboard → Logs (the friend can turn this off). Playback Info says "Not shared" for a friend that doesn't share its hardware. Seeking, the faster start and the logs need the friend on 0.0.193; the token refresh works with any friend.
